what: The menu button floating at top right swaps white ↔ ink in .2s depending on the section background passing under its vertical center — data-tone per section="dark|light" Listing this makes the button pick the value from the last section that starts above the button’s vertical center. So the floating button always stays legible on pages that alternate blue and cream panels

options.from: Section selector, default [data-tone] — each section has its own data-tone="dark"(dark background → button bright)·"light"(Light background → button in ink black)
options.data-tone-now: Current value (dark · light) the part sets on the button — site css may use it to pick icon background colors and so on

use: <button data-fx="under-tone-button" style="position: fixed; top: 30px; right: 30px">…</button> · <section data-tone="dark">…</section><section data-tone="light">…</section>

from.where: shared.js .rl-menu-btn (original navIconColor — [data-js-nav-icon-color=wh|bl] sections’ document positions are lined up in advance and picked at button center height on every scroll, button background transition background-color .2s)

shared.js floating header (.cm-head — the logo, booking and Menu turn to white text in .2s ease-out over the forest-green map and blue closing-photo panels, original header_logo_img__white · header_buttonHamburger__white). data-tone on each panel="dark|light"
